extracted.name: Honey Mustard Grilled Chicken
extracted.description: A creamy honey mustard basting sauce gets added zip from steak sauce in this quick and easy grilled chicken recipe.
instruction_lines: Preheat the grill for medium heat.
In a shallow bowl, mix the mustard, honey, mayonnaise, and steak sauce. Set aside a small amount of the honey mustard sauce for basting, and dip the chicken into the remaining sauce to coat.

Lightly oil the grill grate. Grill chicken over indirect heat for 18 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally, or until juices run clear. Baste occasionally with the reserved sauce during the last 10 minutes. Watch carefully to prevent burning!
